h1: P&R Residence Hotel — Budget Riverside Stay in Bang Rak, 2-Minute Walk to Si Phraya Pier
intro: Tucked into Captain Bush Lane (Charoen Krung 30) — a narrow alley that cuts between the Royal Orchid Sheraton and the Chao Phraya riverbank — P & R Residence Hotel is exactly what it promises: a clean, no-frills base in one of Bangkok's most convenient riverside locations. Twenty rooms, a friendly 24-hour desk, and a 2-3 minute walk to Si Phraya Pier where Chao Phraya Express boats will carry you north to Wat Pho and the Grand Palace or south to Asiatique for as little as ฿15–20. Score 7.6/10 from over 1,000 reviews on Agoda. From approx. ฿950/night.

body.html: Captain Bush Lane is one of those Bangkok addresses that rewards the traveller who does their homework. The short alley — officially Charoen Krung Soi 30 — was historically part of the foreign trading quarter that made Bang Rak the commercial heart of 19th-century Bangkok. Today it sits quietly between the riverside towers of the Royal Orchid Sheraton and the express boat pier, and P & R Residence Hotel at number 34 occupies a position that belies its modest price tag. The pier is genuinely 2-3 minutes on foot; no tuk-tuk, no motorbike taxi needed.

The property has 20 rooms spread across several floors, with a lift. Room types include the Grand Superior (18 sqm, queen bed) and the Grand Deluxe range (20 sqm, king or twin). These are compact rooms — do not expect the proportions of a boutique hotel — but reviewers consistently call them clean and functional. Each room includes air-conditioning, flat-screen satellite TV, free Wi-Fi, a mini-fridge, and hot-water shower. The hotel has free on-site parking, which is a notable bonus in this part of Bangkok.
"Great location for the price — walked to the pier every morning and spent the whole day on the river. Room was small but spotless. Staff were genuinely helpful."

The strongest argument for staying here is the boat access. Si Phraya Pier is served by the Chao Phraya Express orange-flag line, connecting you upriver to Tha Chang (Wat Pho and Grand Palace), Wang Lang, and Phra Athit — and downriver toward Asiatique and beyond. Fares run ฿15–20 per trip. This replaces the need for taxis or BTS for most tourist itineraries and makes for a genuinely enjoyable commute. River City Shopping Complex, Bangkok's antiques and art gallery hub, is a 5-8 minute walk along the riverside.

There are honest limitations to acknowledge. The hotel has no breakfast service, no pool, and no restaurant. The building shows its age in places — some reviewers mention AC noise at night and a few rooms with limited natural light. The lane itself can be tricky to find on first arrival; taxi drivers unfamiliar with the area may need the Royal Orchid Sheraton as a reference point. Tip: tell your driver "near Royal Orchid Sheraton on Charoen Krung" and follow the Google Maps pin. For solo travellers and couples who spend most of the day exploring, none of these are deal-breakers.

For budget-conscious travellers who want a genuine riverside foothold in Bangkok without paying riverside hotel prices, P & R Residence delivers. A score of 7.6/10 from over 1,000 Agoda reviewers is an honest reflection: it is not a boutique hotel, but it is clean, decently run, and located somewhere far more interesting than a generic mid-range block on Sukhumvit. Step out the door, walk two minutes, step onto a boat, and let the Chao Phraya do the rest.

highlights.title: 2-Min Walk to Si Phraya Pier
highlights.text: Step off the boat and you are in your hotel's alley. Chao Phraya Express connects you to Wat Pho, Grand Palace, Chinatown, Asiatique, and ICONSIAM — fares from ฿15.

highlights.title: Best-Value Riverside Location
highlights.text: From approx. ฿950/night for a riverside-access position in Bang Rak — rare at this price point. Free on-site parking adds value for drivers.

highlights.title: Friendly 24-Hour Front Desk
highlights.text: Staff speak Thai, English, and Burmese. Available around the clock for transport help, local tips, and any requests that come up during a Bangkok stay.

honestSummary: P & R Residence Hotel sells location, not luxury. For travellers who want a budget base in Bang Rak with Chao Phraya Express boat access, proximity to River City, and easy reach of Silom and BTS Saphan Taksin — this hotel offers better value than its price suggests. Raise your expectations beyond that and you will need to increase your budget.
honestChecks: If you are driving and need free central Bangkok parking — this hotel offers it, which is genuinely uncommon at this price in the area → a hidden advantage for road-trippers
If your itinerary revolves around river temples, markets, and boat travel — the location is nearly unbeatable at this price point → strong recommendation for boat-based sightseeing
If you want full hotel amenities (pool, breakfast, restaurant) — those are not available here → consider upgrading to Jasaen Stylish Boutique or Centre Point Plus Silom

tips.title: Take the boat instead of BTS
tips.body: Si Phraya Pier is far closer than BTS Saphan Taksin. The orange-flag Chao Phraya Express goes north to Tha Chang (Wat Pho, Grand Palace) and south to Asiatique — fares ฿15-20.

tips.title: Tell your taxi "near Royal Orchid Sheraton"
tips.body: Captain Bush Lane (Charoen Krung Soi 30) is hard to find the first time. Give Royal Orchid Sheraton as your landmark — the hotel is in the same alley.

tips.title: Breakfast is easy to find nearby
tips.body: No in-house breakfast, but noodle shops, rice porridge stalls, and coffee spots open from early morning along Charoen Krung and near River City — 3-5 minutes on foot.

tips.title: Explore River City on foot
tips.body: River City Shopping Complex is a 5-8 minute walk — Bangkok's best antique and art gallery destination, with riverside cafes on the ground floor.

faqTitle: FAQ — P&R Residence Hotel, Bang Rak, Bangkok

faq.q: Where is P&R Residence Hotel Bangkok and how close is it to BTS Saphan Taksin?
faq.a: P & R Residence Hotel is at 34 Captain Bush Lane (Charoen Krung Soi 30), Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500. Si Phraya Pier (Chao Phraya Express) is just 2-3 minutes on foot. BTS Saphan Taksin is approximately 1.1 km away — an 18-minute walk or a short motorbike taxi ride.

faq.q: What is the starting price at P&R Residence Hotel Bangkok?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. ฿950/night for a Grand Superior room (18 sqm, queen bed). Grand Deluxe King rooms (20 sqm) typically run ฿1,050–1,200/night depending on the season and booking platform.

faq.q: Does P&R Residence Hotel have breakfast or a pool?
faq.a: The hotel does not offer breakfast and has no swimming pool. It does offer free on-site parking. Breakfast options including noodle shops, congee stalls, and coffee shops are within 3-5 minutes on foot of the hotel.

faq.q: Where can you go from Si Phraya Pier?
faq.a: Si Phraya Pier is served by the Chao Phraya Express orange-flag line. Heading upstream: Tha Chang (Wat Pho, Grand Palace), Wang Lang, Phra Athit. Downstream: Asiatique and beyond. Fares start at ฿15-20 per trip.

faq.q: Who is P&R Residence Hotel best suited for?
faq.a: It suits budget-conscious solo travellers or couples who plan to explore Bangkok by river, and business travellers who need free parking near Silom-Sathorn. It is not recommended for those who need full hotel amenities such as a pool, restaurant, or breakfast.
